mentions.name: SprigEdit
mentions.description: SprigEdit is a WYSIWYG markdown editor focused on a beautiful and pleasant writing experience. It is fully native while running on web, Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android, using a shared core with a platform-native UI layer.
